_note: Existing café hooks retained; new drinks-terrace overrides describe its integrated painting. fumeur is a text-only plaque.

fr_lunette_noun.hook: "lew-NEHT": LUNAR NETS! These GLASSES have two crescent MOONS for lenses: LUNAR specs.
fr_lunette_noun.why: English sound-alike LUNAR (moon) instead of French la lune; the moon-lens glasses are painted.

fr_asseoir_verb.hook: "sah-SWAHR": "SAH, SWERVE!": Monsieur Verbe SWERVES past everyone and SITS DOWN in the last free chair, admiring himself in his hand mirror.
fr_asseoir_verb.why: Complete English sound-alike; the man sitting with the mirror is painted.

fr_tasse_noun.hook: "TAHS": the laughing café boy TOSSES the CUP right off its saucer, coffee and all!
fr_tasse_noun.why: The tosser is now a boy, not a dressed mouse.

fr_cafe_noun.hook: A sleepy man in a striped nightcap hugs a cup of black COFFEE to wake up: CAFÉ, the same word as the place where you drink it.
fr_cafe_noun.why: The owl was not the hook, so it became a sleepy man in pajamas (no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal is the hook); same change in the café shelf and in the zoom.

fr_sandwich_noun.hook: A little boy kneels on the floor and bites a giant SANDWICH, and SAND pours out of it. French says sahn-DWEETSH.

fr_serviette_noun_2.hook: A napkin folded into a swan sits by a little bell, waiting: "SERVE YET?" (sehr-VYEHT). British English even says serviette for a napkin. (In the bathroom, la serviette is the towel.)
fr_serviette_noun_2.why: RECS 1.4: napkin sense split from the towel (fr_serviette_noun, maison/bains).

fr_dire_verb.hook: "DEER": Monsieur Verbe SAYS "Bonjour!" to a little DEER on the café table, waving hello. dire = to say.

fr_salade_noun.hook: Like English 'salad', said sah-LAHD: the SALAD bowl wears a little flat cap like a schoolboy.
fr_salade_noun.why: American words 2026-10-28: the meaning word in capitals changed to its American form (same painting).

fr_jus_noun.hook: A baby giraffe from the ZOO (ZHEW) leans its long neck over a tall glass of ORANGE JUICE with a straw, standing on the counter.
fr_jus_noun.why: Split repaint: the giraffe now leans over the juice glass on the counter instead of sipping through a curly straw.

fr_barman_noun.hook: The BAR MAN shakes a silver shaker of fruit juice behind the counter.
fr_barman_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_gueridon_noun.hook: GERRY the DON rests a teacup on a small round pedestal TABLE.
fr_gueridon_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_soda_noun.hook: A glass of fizzy SODA bubbles over its rim.
fr_soda_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_buveur_noun.hook: A BEAVER is a thirsty milk DRINKER, holding a large glass in both paws.
fr_buveur_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_carafe_noun.hook: The waitress pours water from a tall glass CARAFE into a tumbler.
fr_carafe_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_apero_noun.hook: APES in a ROW share orange juice, chips and olives before supper: an APÉRO.
fr_apero_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.
fr_apero_noun.note: Informal for apéritif: the pre-dinner drinks and snacks occasion. The pictured drinks are alcohol-free.

fr_breuvage_noun.hook: A BREW in a VASE makes a purple magic BEVERAGE.
fr_breuvage_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_fast_food_noun.hook: A burger and fries are ready on a red tray: FAST FOOD.
fr_fast_food_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_non_fumeur_noun.hook: A kitten fans the fresh air beside a clean-air notice: a NON-FUMEUR.
fr_non_fumeur_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.

fr_fumeur_noun.hook: A plain blank wall PLAQUE presents this vocabulary as text only.
fr_fumeur_noun.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.
fr_fumeur_noun.note: This word is presented as text only on a blank wall plaque.
